summary: Iter 3 testing complete. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (api root + 10 atlas volumes incl. 4 new standard atlases + 4 labels JSONs + old-wang removal). Frontend: all critical features verified — sidebar order is correct (Base→Lesion→ROIs→Activation→Drawing→Atlases→Retinotopy→Tracts), upload-base-button present, all 4 standard atlas toggles + upload-atlas-button present, upload-tract-button accepts .trk/.tck/.trx/.vtk/.gii/.mz3, AAL atlas loads and renders, label-at-crosshair works correctly ('AAL Insula_L', 'AAL Hippocampus_L', 'AAL Cerebellum_6_L' at clicked points), retinotopy opacity slider (verified 85%→20% display + visible fade) and colormap dropdown (hsv→plasma) both work — confirming the volumeMap<id,NVImage> bug fix is effective. Drawing panel save/undo/clear appear when drawing-toggle activated. All previous flows (5 slice modes, clip plane, crosshair toggle, screenshot, retinotopy 4 layers, polar disc/eccen bar) still functional.

minor.issue: File has .nii.gz extension but content is uncompressed NIfTI-1 (magic 5c010000, not gzip 1f8b). Functionally works in niivue (auto-detects format) but is misleading and slightly larger over the wire. Other 3 standard atlases (HO cort/sub, Juelich) are correctly gzipped.

action_items: Optional: re-gzip aal_atlas.nii.gz so the on-disk file matches its extension (e.g. `gunzip -t` would fail today). Niivue handles it but other consumers / curl-based pipelines may not.
Nice-to-have: when crosshair-labels has zero entries the element is unmounted (CrosshairInfo conditional render). For tests that always want the element present, render an empty span. Not critical.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is now ~520 lines and still trending upward each iteration. The four user-layer sections (lesion/roi/activation/custom-atlas) share identical structure — consider extracting <UserLayerSection type=... /> to reduce duplication.

NiivueViewer.replaceBaseVolume re-adds previous overlays via nv.addVolume(ov) after removing them, but overlays were obtained from nv.volumes.slice(1) BEFORE the for-loop that calls nv.removeVolume(v). This is OK because removeVolume only detaches; but ensure niivue does not invalidate the NVImage refs internally. If users hit issues replacing base while overlays are active, log a warning.
atlasLabelsRef.current is keyed by atlas id but never cleared on atlas remove — minor memory holdover; harmless for current size.
FileUploader data-testid still on hidden <input>; works with set_input_files but not is_visible(). Documented in iter-2 already.
handleAtlasToggle / handleRetToggle still not useCallback-memoised — LayerControl rerenders unnecessarily. Low priority.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 3 fully validated. Critical bug fix confirmed: retinotopy/atlas opacity & colormap controls now correctly target the right NVImage via volumeMap<id,NVImage> in NiivueViewer — verified visually (Polar Angle opacity 85→20% fade + colormap hsv→plasma swap both rendered). rca_of_the_issue: Iter 3 root cause of the previously-reported retinotopy-controls-do-nothing bug: NiivueViewer.findIndex was matching by volume.name === id, but niivue overwrites .name to the URL basename after addVolumeFromUrl. Fix: Dashboard pushes vol.name = layerCfg.id manually after add, AND keeps a separate Map<id,NVImage> (volumeMap.current) so findVolume(id) returns the right NVImage regardless of niivue's internal renaming. setOverlayOpacity(id,v) and setOverlayColormap(id,cm) both use this map → confirmed working.
